svg.title: OpenIE-Apex-Harness Closure Across the Four Late-2026 Frontier AI Walls
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-45 through LA-48 and 82 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1446 fleet): (A) Official 16-environment ARC-AGI-3 interactive reasoning with Iterated Width IW(1) and causal click pruning; (B) NVlabs/verilog-eval v2 hard-tail RTL hardware synthesis and ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench Level-2 Apple Metal GPU fusion; (C) PutnamBench and FormalConjectures 24-theorem pure Lean 4.36.0 proof synthesis with Wave-2 .lut6 tactic crystallization; and (D) H=256-step coupled operational, openie-cad PCB/thermal, and MathGround Torricelli CBF horizon survival plus Jetson AGX Thor DC shunt Window 16 measured_j.
